title.zh: Paxos的USDG稳定币在Arbitrum上线并加入Global Dollar网络
title.en: Paxos' USDG stablecoin launches on Arbitrum and joins Global Dollar Network

current_state.zh: Paxos' $3B Global Dollar (USDG) stablecoin launched natively on Arbitrum One with DeFi integrations, Kraken support and Stargate bridging, alongside an ArbitrumDAO proposal to earmark 100 million ARB for adoption incentives and liquidity.
current_state.en: Paxos' $3B Global Dollar (USDG) stablecoin launched natively on Arbitrum One with DeFi integrations, Kraken support and Stargate bridging, alongside an ArbitrumDAO proposal to earmark 100 million ARB for adoption incentives and liquidity.

updates.title_zh: Arbitrum joins Paxos-led stablecoin group Global Dollar to capture digital dollar growth
updates.title_en: Arbitrum joins Paxos-led stablecoin group Global Dollar to capture digital dollar growth
updates.what_changed_zh: Arbitrum joined the Paxos-led Global Dollar Network, backing USDG and rolling it out across its DeFi ecosystem with Kraken providing on- and off-ramps, as it seeks a share of stablecoin reserve economics on a chain holding roughly $3.8 billion in stablecoins.
